title: Library tiles are as wide as the mock draws them, so a file name reads whole
goal: The Library shelf draws its tiles 68 points wide with a short fixed picture, three to a row, so a recording called Tutorial Sample.mp4 reads Tutor....mp4. The video mock draws them at least 96 wide with a 16 by 10 picture, two to a row in a resting dock, and no name cut.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html Library group (#gLibrary) and docs/design/mocks/shared/AGENTS.md ~line 1201: .libgrid repeat(auto-fill,minmax(96px,1fr)), .libtile .th aspect-ratio 16/10. App: Sources/PhotonzCore/LibraryShelfLayout.swift tileMinimumWidth = 68, fixed thumbnailHeight; LibraryShelfLayoutTests pin the numbers. Seen 2026-09-25 in /tmp/photonz-playtest/library-import-walk/2-imported-sc.png (Tutor....mp4). First raised by the manager on 2026-09-24 in the log of recordings-and-sounds-can-go-into-the-library-wi from queue/audits/2026-09-23-library-clips.json. Walks to rerun: shelf-tile-reveal-walk, library-shelf-height-walk, library-walk, starter-shelf-walk, library-import-walk. DONE 2026-09-27: LibraryShelfLayout.Sizing (.compact Current, .card Next via flag next-library-tiles-as-cards); every size is width(shelf)-dependent via tileWidth/thumbnailHeight/tileHeight(width:sizing:). LibraryPanel passes LibraryTileMetrics down the environment (\.libraryTile) and reports its floor through onMetrics' third arg into DockBudgetScratch.shelfFloor. PlaytestHarness shelfTurnLimit raised 70 -> 130 for taller cards.
acceptance: At the dock's resting width the Media shelf shows two tiles to a row, each at least 96 points wide, with a 16 by 10 picture
Tutorial Sample.mp4, b-roll.mp4 and Sample Music.m4a read whole under their tiles
Components and Styles tiles follow the same rule without their walks breaking
A picture of the shelf sits beside video.html's Library in the audit, differences listed

log.note: triage 2026-09-25 spot-check: confirmed. LibraryShelfLayout.tileMinimumWidth is 68 and thumbnailHeight 44, and /tmp/photonz-playtest/library-import-walk/2-imported-sc.png (01:17 today) shows the tile named Tutor....mp4 beside b-roll.mp4, three to a row.
owns these walks: library-import-walk, shelf-tile-reveal-walk, library-shelf-height-walk, library-walk, starter-shelf-walk

Adversarial pass before building: the mock's 16:10 picture makes a tile's height depend on dock width, so the shelf height, reveal and the dock's squeeze floor (which assumed a fixed row) all had to take the width; a fixed floor would cut the caption of the row it keeps in a wide dock. The narrowest dock gives one ~139pt tile per row, which is the mock's own rule. Kept Current on its 68pt tiles behind a Next-only flag.

Verified: Scripts/test.sh 10044 tests green; 15 shelf/library walks pass (playtest-all shelf library), library-import-walk shows Tutorial Sample.mp4, b-roll.mp4, Sample Music.m4a whole, two to a row. Side by side with video.html's Library: size now matches (114x90 vs mock 112x105; the height gap is the mock's second caption line); the card look (border, edge-to-edge picture, left name, length line) differs and is filed p1 as library-tiles-look-like-the-mock-s-cards-with-th.

Next's Library shelf draws 96pt+ tiles, two to a row at rest, with a 16:10 picture (LibraryShelfLayout.Sizing.card behind next-library-tiles-as-cards, on in Next). Names read whole.
